note: Carries the two rebinds from transition-2026-09-04 forward unchanged (both already written into editorial.json, no-ops here) so the applied set is never split across files. New this run: 94 rebinds from one operation, not 94 decisions. Every listed URL on the shelf was knocked on 2026-09-05 (POST {} then GET); 33 of 522 answered HTTP 402 at the address we publish. For these 94 the entry pointed at a site root or a non-paying path while the SAME HOST published an x402 discovery manifest naming a resource that answers 402. The rebind appends the well-known path to a host already listed — the origin never changes, so this is a correction to the address, not a change of what is listed. CONTRIBUTING.md accepts a manifest as the door in two places, and the submission gate follows one as of 2026-09-05. Cross-host candidates found by mining READMEs were NOT applied: a wrapper, CLI or MCP server is not the service it calls, and rebinding one to the other would list two artifacts at one address. Those stay as they are.

rebind.reason: gold-402 PR #148 (cavany-tech): operator repointed the entry from Email Verification to URL Extraction as the primary resource. Probed 2026-08-28 before rebinding — POST /v1/extract returns 402 with a base64 payment-required header carrying a valid x402 v2 challenge ($0.002 USDC, eip155:8453). Same operator, same service line, first_listed carried. Applied 2026-08-28; carried forward here as a no-op. Carried forward from transition-2026-09-04 so the applied set is never split across files; a no-op here.

gold-402 PR #180 (chico10117): operator moved x402 Preflight off the Vercel preview host onto the domain they own. Same service, same method, same request shape, same $0.05 USDC price on Base, description unchanged. Probed 2026-09-04T22:01Z before merging — the exact new URL returns HTTP 402. Host move only, so first_listed is carried from the original listing. Carried forward from transition-2026-09-04 so the applied set is never split across files; a no-op here.
